Eight people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, on alleged federal violations and are being held under U.S. Marshals holds, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search. An arrest is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.

Pedro Huerta-Quintero

Huerta-Quintero was arrested Wednesday at 11:56 a.m. on an alleged federal violation. The booking record did not specify a charge class, and no bond amount or case number was listed. He is held under a U.S. Marshals hold.
